evals.prompt: Run a full money audit of the app in ./coinjar and write the report.
evals.expected_output: money-audit/money-map.md, money-audit/findings.json and money-audit/REPORT.md inside ./coinjar, a findings file the validator accepts, and most of the planted bugs found.
assertions: money-audit/money-map.md, money-audit/findings.json and money-audit/REPORT.md exist in the audited copy.
scripts/validate-findings.mjs prints VALID for the findings file with the audited copy as --root.
node playground/score.mjs on the findings file reports at least 14 of the 17 planted bugs as found.
No file of the audited copy outside money-audit/ was modified.
No app process is left running when the audit ends.

evals.prompt: Look only at routes/postback.mjs in ./coinjar. Can a postback be forged or replayed?
evals.expected_output: A short answer about that one file, with file and line for each way a postback can be forged, replayed or reversed twice.
assertions: The answer names the debug=1 bypass of the hash check with its file and line.
The answer names the check-then-insert duplicate window and the reversal that is not tied to its credit.
No money-audit folder or other file is created, because this is a focused check.

evals.prompt: Run a full money audit of the app in ./coinjar-fixed.
evals.expected_output: A valid report with no critical or high findings, and a guard named for every class recorded as clear.
assertions: scripts/validate-findings.mjs prints VALID for the findings file.
No finding is rated critical or high.
Each class recorded as clear names the guard that makes it safe, such as the unique (kind, ref) ledger key or the conditional debit.
